resources.string: Changes records what you and whoever supports your care have decided. It does not give medical advice, does not suggest doses and does not replace professional care.

Changes works fully offline. Everything you record stays on this device only: the app has no internet access and does not send, sync or share your data with anyone, in any way. Data only leaves this device if you export a backup yourself.

resources.string: If you are going through a difficult moment, you do not have to face it without support.
CVV, Centro de Valorização da Vida (Brazil)
Free call to 188, 24 hours a day. Chat is also available at cvv.org.br.
Mental health care through SUS, the Brazilian public health system. Your nearest primary care unit can tell you where the CAPS in your area is.
